sections.title: Public Sector
sections.subtitle: Connect citizen requests with agency workflows—accessible, traceable and secure by design.

backgroundImage.alt: Public service building and citizen services

sections.heading: Public services designed around people
sections.body:
Citizens need clear routes to services; agency teams need connected systems, accountable case ownership and protected information. Linkfields combines application modernisation, enterprise platforms, automation and governed Data & AI around that shared journey.

Accessibility, language support, assisted channels and traceable records are requirements to agree during discovery. We define access, human-review and data-sharing boundaries before designing change, rather than treating technology as proof of compliance.

sections.heading: Five portfolios, shaped around your work

items.title: Digital Transformation
items.description: Modernise citizen channels and connect applications with assisted-service hand-offs.

items.title: Intelligent Enterprise Platforms
items.description: Connect agency finance, procurement and operational applications.

items.title: Data & AI
items.description: Build governed case-demand analytics and controlled document insight.

items.title: Cyber Security
items.description: Design identity, application and cloud controls around citizen-data sensitivity.

items.title: Talent Advisory & GCC
items.description: Align roadmaps, specialist capacity and managed delivery with agency needs.

sections.heading: What we deliver
sections.description: Define the citizen journey, staff responsibilities and evidence needed at each hand-off.

items.title: Citizen application and status journeys
items.description: When citizens repeat information across channels, connect enquiries, applications and status updates with the team responsible for the request.
items.bullets:
Discovery – agree language, accessibility and assisted-channel hand-offs.
Control – verify identity and route exceptions to authorised staff.
items.footText: Journey completion, hand-off effort and status-update clarity.

items.title: Case and document ownership
items.description: When records and approvals are fragmented, connect document intake, validation and routing with named case owners.
items.bullets:
Control – staff review evidence and approve public-service decisions.
Output – ownership trail, approval record and agreed retention controls.
items.footText: Case rework, approval time and evidence completeness.

items.title: Controlled agency data integration
items.description: When agency systems cannot exchange necessary information, define APIs and data contracts for the approved sharing purpose.
items.bullets:
Control – agree role-based access, record scope and exception review.
Output – interface specifications and a traceable data-sharing flow.
items.footText: Data completeness, failed exchanges and reconciliation effort.

items.title: Service-demand and resource planning
items.description: When planning relies on disconnected counts, combine case volumes, service demand and operational records into governed reporting.
items.bullets:
Control – planners review definitions, data quality and access.
Output – metric catalogue and planning dashboards; no autonomous public decisions.
items.footText: Reporting freshness and consistency of planning inputs.

sections.heading: Software for accountable public services
sections.description: Select capabilities against approved workflows and data boundaries, not assumed government accreditation.

items.title: Linkworks
items.description: Composable citizen and case applications where ERP or CRM does not fit. Tailor journeys, roles and application integrations to agency scope.

items.title: textIQ
items.description: Search and insight across unstructured operational documents. Define authorised sources, access boundaries and staff review of findings.

items.title: AI Governance
items.description: The Linkfields AI gateway and guardrail layer, built on Portkey and Opik, brings controls, cost visibility and tracing to approved AI tools.

items.title: Intelligent Workflow Automation
items.description: Reusable routing, approval, AI orchestration and application-integration IP. Agency staff remain accountable for case decisions and exceptions.

sections.note: Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without services. Workflow accelerators are configured and tailored during delivery.

sections.heading: Start with a citizen journey or agency workflow
sections.description: Which citizen journey or agency workflow needs to work better? Discuss delivery requirements or procurement scope without sharing citizen records.

items.title: Define the service and controls
items.description: Map citizen and assisted channels, case ownership and records. Agree accessibility and language requirements, data permissions and human-review points.
items.bullets:
Artefacts – service blueprint and responsibility matrix
Acceptance – agreed journey, access and accessibility checks

items.title: Prepare delivery and procurement scope
items.description: Linkfields is headquartered in South Africa, with an Offshore Delivery Centre in India and international market presence. Agree delivery accountability, data boundaries and procurement requirements.
items.bullets:
Discussion – contracting scope, delivery roles and evidence requirements
Artefacts – proposed architecture, control matrix and acceptance plan

items.title: Agree a measurable next step
items.description: Choose discovery scope and acceptance measures first. Consider Fixed Price, Time & Materials, Managed Service or a Dedicated Team according to the requirement and procurement process.

sections.note: Describe the service problem, agency systems and constraints. We can agree an NDA before sharing confidential information.
